name: termux-app
description_en: Termux - a terminal emulator application for Android OS extendible by variety of packages.
readme_excerpt: Termux application Termux is an Android terminal application and Linux environment. Note that this repository is for the app itself (the user interface and the terminal emulation). For the packages installable inside the app, see termux/termux-packages. Quick how-to about Termux package management is available at Package Management.
